cards.title: The Connected Sales Chain
items: Lead -> Order -> PDI -> TMS -> Dispatch remains the connected operational path; named FMS events coordinate hand-offs.
Dispatch posts outbound stock; upstream order/PPC reservations share getStockAvailability. Other legitimate inventory/production stock actions also exist.
Customer Portal uses a revocable per-customer link for that customer's own orders and Issued invoices. Barcode scanning is implemented; physical-device verification is separate.

cards.title: Accounts — INR Is Authoritative
items: Receivables and Payables post journal entries to the double-entry GL; Trial Balance, P&L and Balance Sheet use that ledger. Tally XML export is implemented.
Aging is NOT a GL-only projection: getReceivablesAging sums Issued invoices per ORDER, subtracts order_payments, and ages from the earliest invoice.
GST export reads Issued sales invoices and purchase bills, with output GST and input tax; it is GSTR-shaped support for manual filing, not government e-filing.
Sources: src/lib/accounts/accounts.ts:545-631,742-884; src/lib/accounts/ledger.ts; src/lib/accounts/tally-export.ts.

cards.title: FMS, Production & People
items: FMS remains the no-code engine: forms, lookup fields, working-hours TAT, branching and stock actions; Inward/PPC/Purchase events feed workflow hand-offs.

Template Builder help is implemented: first-visit explainer via localStorage, always reopenable. Services, Complaints and Site Visits add assigned field-work cycles; advances/expenses are not automatic Accounts postings.

Payroll includes join/exit proration and opt-in simplified PF/ESI/TDS deductions with shortfall capping. This is NOT statutory certification or return filing; embedded rate assumptions need accountant review.
Sources: src/components/fms-builder-help.tsx; src/app/fms/fms-template-form.tsx:546; src/lib/payroll/payroll.ts:393-447; src/lib/payroll/statutory.ts:1-23.

cards.title: Tenant Access — Source, Not a Security Guarantee
items: Tenant-owned business data is org-scoped through tenant context and module/role guards; platform reference tables such as currencies are intentionally NOT per-org.
Admin manages module access, API keys and currency settings. Task leave-buddy reassignment and its audit records remain part of People Ops.
Tenant transactions/advisory locks and durable mutation_receipts protect their participating paths; this is not a claim that every operation is race-free or every request is idempotent.
Source snapshot includes concurrent uncommitted security/UI changes. No full-security guarantee, audit-passed claim, or production acceptance is made.

cards.title: Read-only REST API — Implemented
items: GET /api/v1/orders, /api/v1/invoices, /api/v1/stock, /api/v1/customers, /api/v1/vendors and /api/v1/dispatches use API-key Bearer authentication, independent of cookie login.
Key hashes/revocation are implemented; withApiKeyTenant resolves the owning organization and runs existing domain reads in explicit tenant context. These endpoints do not provide third-party writes.
limit/cursor responses paginate already-loaded arrays (default 50, max 200), NOT indexed DB pagination. Orders/Invoices/Dispatches support their documented status filters.
Rate-limit hardening in src/lib/auth/apiKeyGuard.ts is currently uncommitted work, not an accepted production security result.
Sources: src/app/api/v1/*/route.ts; src/lib/auth/apiKeyGuard.ts; src/lib/apiAccess/apiKeys.ts; src/lib/apiAccess/pagination.ts.

cards.title: domain_events -> Two Independent Cron Consumers
items: The append-only org-scoped domain_events log is shared infrastructure, distinct from the named FMS hand-off engine. Call sites emit order.status_changed, stock.movement_recorded, task.assigned and approval.pending.

Webhooks poll order.status_changed + stock.movement_recorded. Raw JSON POST bodies carry X-Pro-ERP-Signature = sha256=<HMAC-SHA256>; subscriptions track cursors and deliveries track attempts/retries. Do not assume exactly-once delivery.

POST/GET /api/cron/dispatch-webhooks and /api/cron/dispatch-notifications require the cron bearer secret. Their source requests separate VPS system-cron entries every 1-2 minutes; actual scheduler installation/delivery was NOT checked here.
Current webhook URL filtering rejects obvious local/private literal hosts only: DNS-resolution/rebinding and redirect-target defenses remain concrete hardening gaps in this source snapshot.
Sources: src/lib/events/emit.ts; src/lib/apiAccess/webhooks.ts:28-76,210-363; src/app/api/cron/dispatch-{webhooks,notifications}/route.ts.

cards.title: Notification Bell — Implemented, Polling
items: task.assigned -> assigned doer; approval.pending -> leave approver; order.status_changed -> order creator. Stock movement is deliberately excluded from the human inbox.
Task creation/recurring occurrence and leave approval progression emit the events in current source; older CLAUDE roadmap notes saying notification center is not started are stale.

Cron converts relevant domain_events into per-user notifications, then advances an org cursor. Header bell polls /api/notifications every 30 seconds, shows unread count and supports mark-read; not WebSocket push.
Runtime duplicate/overlapping-cron behavior and real multi-user delivery still need dedicated deployment verification; source existence is not proof of scheduler operation.
Sources: src/lib/tasks.ts:136,182; src/lib/leave/leaves.ts:203-216,357; src/lib/notifications/dispatch.ts:23-174; src/components/notification-bell.tsx:31-93; src/components/sidebar-shell.tsx:157,225.

cards.title: Reference Currency + Opt-in Order-Payment Forex
items: Supported reference currencies: INR, USD, EUR, GBP, AED. INR remains the authoritative base for credit checks, accounting and reports; foreign face amount, currency and rate are document snapshots.

Admin enables currencies and manually appends historical effective-from rates. Order, invoice and purchase-order creation snapshot their rate/face amount; existing documents do not float when rates change. No automatic market-rate feed.

Only explicit faceAmountReceived on an eligible foreign-currency ORDER PAYMENT activates realized FX posting: AR clears at order snapshot rate; Cash/Bank uses the current configured rate; delta posts Forex Gain 4100 or Forex Loss 5600.
Ordinary INR payments retain the ordinary path. This is NOT vendor-settlement FX, a foreign-currency GL, historical payment-date revaluation, or multi-company books.

Sources: src/db/schema/currency.ts; src/lib/currency/currency.ts:19-25,127-217,257-277; src/lib/orders/orders.ts:939-1110; src/lib/accounts/accounts.ts:338-355; src/lib/purchase/orders.ts:413-432; src/lib/accounts/ledger.ts:99-104.

cards.title: Personal Workspace & Bulk Actions
items: Dashboard per-user widget preferences support show/hide and up/down reorder, not drag-and-drop. Admin onboarding uses four EXISTS-based steps with per-org dismissal.
Orders and Inventory use reusable SavedViewsBar with per-user saved filter/search state; this is not an org-shared report view.

Orders bulk actions respect same-status/eligible next steps or cancellation, call existing per-row endpoints and surface partial failures; not one all-or-nothing batch transaction. Inventory supports selected-row CSV export.

Sources: src/app/dashboard/page.tsx:161-177,421; src/lib/userSettings.ts; src/lib/onboarding.ts; src/components/saved-views-bar.tsx; src/app/orders/orders-board.tsx:108-314; src/app/inventory/inventory-board.tsx:232-265.

cards.title: Actual Hosting Topology — Not Vercel / Managed Neon
items: Documented live architecture: self-hosted Hostinger VPS, Nginx TLS/reverse proxy -> PM2-managed Next.js -> neon-local-proxy sidecar -> local Postgres. Drizzle retains the Neon protocol driver, NOT a managed Neon database.
Attachments are local disk uploads outside the application checkout, served by Nginx /uploads. App storage writes via UPLOADS_DIR; this is NOT Vercel Blob.
Deploy remains manual build/restart; scheduled work uses system cron, not Vercel Cron. This map update did not SSH, deploy, migrate, inspect production configuration, or verify live health.
Health code checks database/schema readiness; a ready health response would not establish backup restore, delivery reliability or security approval.
Sources: README.md:3-5,23-33,95-97; CLAUDE.md:87-101 (infra record); src/db/local-proxy.ts:14-24; src/db/client.ts; src/lib/storage.ts.

cards.title: Pending / Deliberately Out of Scope
items: Deployment acceptance: verify new migrations, both cron entries, real signed webhook receiver/retry behavior and per-user notification delivery against an authorized environment. These were not exercised for this artifact.

Billing: Subscriptions backend exists behind assertSubscriptionsReady; latest project notes leave real sandbox subscribe -> payment -> renewal -> cancellation and credential rotation pending. No live enabled/disabled flag was inspected. SaaS GST receipt is documented blocked on business GST details.

Compliance/features: manual GST filing, simplified payroll assumptions, no vendor-settlement FX or multi-company books, and deferred email delivery remain distinct limitations; do not relabel implemented reference currency as full multi-currency accounting.

Capacity/verification: API pagination and global search remain memory-based; physical barcode camera proof and tenant aggregate upload quotas remain separate follow-ups. Review current release plans before treating historical checklist items as live blockers.

Security/UI hardening is concurrently in progress and uncommitted (login/API throttling, uploads, financial input bounds, mutation idempotency). This diagram does NOT certify those changes or repeat old audit-pass claims.
